name: CurvedLoop-TS-TW
blurb: Text flows along a curved SVG path in a looping marquee, draggable to control.
description: Renders text on a curved path using SVG textPath and continuously scrolls it. Supports drag-to-control and adjustable curve amount and speed.
use_when: A decorative full-width marquee that needs curvature and fine-grained control over text flow.
avoid_when: When SVG rendering is restricted or if complex text with bidirectional content is needed.
a11y: Text is rendered in SVG; screen readers may struggle with textPath content. No keyboard navigation for drag control.
